scientific_integrity: Proof uses Kummer carries, an exact orthogonal finite-cosine decomposition, and a Perron-Frobenius cylinder measure. Exact finite computational checks corroborate only tested cases. Historical priority has not been independently established.
scientific_limitations: Fixed prime nondivisibility only, not modulo higher powers or full residue distribution; no arbitrary-cutoff asymptotic equivalent and no claim that the binary specialization is new. Equivalent published digit-constraint results may exist.
source_ids: B. Sury, Journal of Integer Sequences 12 (2009), Article 09.7.5
title: Prime-relative Fuss–Catalan nondivisibility: exact spectra and p-adic dimension
